Baraka signed an executive order last night at the City’s 38th Annual Sing in Praise of King event honoring Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. “ICE cannot come into our public buildings if they are not doing public business without a judicial warrant,” he stated. The mayor also stated that the executive order directs the police agency not to cooperate with ICE in any form whatsoever. The order prohibits ICE agents from using city-owned property, facilities or resources for unconstitutional civil immigration enforcement actions and from entering city buildings without a legitimate government purpose or necessary judicial warrant.
